body:
I saved the cloth with red grit for you. The pasture study crew passed the first hot day; the flies vanished, and afterward a patrol turned us back.

The person beside me recognized the handwriting and went quiet. We had been told not to rely on yesterday’s directions.

The younger one wanted to throw it away. I promised we would ask in the morning, and put it where neither of us could forget.
title: the first hot day — red grit
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same red grit while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
